brief.lane.builder.text: You are the builder of a lane in {project} that the user started: use the card-loop skill as the builder{reviewer, select, agent {, with {reviewerName} as the reviewer} pool {, reviewed by the pool ({pool}): Combwork gives each card you submit to a free reviewer of it, and its lane is registered already, so give cw_lane no reviewer} other {, with no reviewer}}; rounds: {rounds}.
brief.lane.builder.note: #1280: the builder's brief's first line. reviewer: agent (reviewerName reviews), pool (#1443: the project's reviewer pool, its agents joined, or brief.lane.poolEmpty) or none.

brief.lane.builderMoves.text: Ask Combwork for your next card with cw_lane next. Move cards by what you did: cw_start_card, cw_submit with a summary, and cw_report_merge after a merge. A refused move says what to do next; do that. Questions for the user go through cw_ask_user, requests for the Assistant through cw_ask_assistant, reports as comments on the card.
brief.lane.builderMoves.note: How the builder moves cards and asks: the intents, and where questions go.

brief.lane.cards.text: The cards, one at a time in this order:
brief.lane.cards.note: Above the cards, one a line ("1. AL-1 Lane data").

brief.lane.note.note: The note the user wrote as they started the lane, as they wrote it.

brief.lane.poolEmpty.note: The reviewer pool, with no agent in it yet: in brief.lane.builder.

brief.lane.reviewer.text: You are the reviewer of {builder}'s lane in {project} that the user started: use the card-loop skill as the reviewer; rounds: {rounds}.

brief.lane.reviewerMoves.text: Wait for each card in Review, then cw_start_review and cw_verdict on the revision it names. Questions for the builder go through cw_request_builder, for the user through cw_ask_user, for the Assistant through cw_ask_assistant.
brief.lane.reviewerMoves.note: How the reviewer reviews and asks.

brief.lane.rules.note: Above the project's rules (brief.rule.*), a line each.

brief.lane.where.text: {place, select, slot {{builder} works in {slot}, a new branch per card (Combwork makes each card's branch there from the target and gives the card to {builder} there)} folder {{builder} works in {folder}{hasBranch, select, yes { (branch {branch})} other {}}} other {{builder} works in the project folder}}{hasTarget, select, yes {; work goes to {target}} other {}}.
brief.lane.where.note: #1438: where the builder works: its slot (a new branch per card), its folder (and branch), or the project folder; and the target its work goes to.

brief.record.brief.note: A lane's brief as its builder reads it (with each card in slots, or delivered): who started the lane (from: the lane's startedBy), then the brief as it was written (text).

brief.record.byHive.text: {agent} is running, so Combwork left it as it is: Combwork gives it the lane's first card itself once it is free, so don't prompt it.
brief.record.byHive.note: HI-2029: a running builder, the rules on: Combwork gives it the lane's first card once it is free, so the caller is told not to prompt it (that would race Combwork's start).

brief.record.cleared.note: The lane change's reply: the lane's brief was cleared.

brief.record.deferred.text: {agent} wasn't free: Combwork gives it the lane in a new conversation once it is, so don't prompt it.
brief.record.deferred.note: HI-2034: an agent not free yet is owed its new conversation, given once it is free.

brief.record.delivered.text: Its brief is delivered to the builder now.
brief.record.delivered.note: The lane change's reply: the brief is delivered to the builder's inbox.

brief.record.failed.note: failed: each agent that failed to start (brief.record.failedOne), joined by "; ". The lane is recorded: the caller starts them, or ends the lane.

brief.record.failedOne.note: One agent that failed to start on the lane, with why (unknown when there is none). Joined by "; " into brief.record.failed.

brief.record.fresh.text: Gave {agent} the lane in a new conversation (its last stays in its Sessions history): don't prompt it.
brief.record.fresh.note: HI-2232: an idle agent given the lane in a new conversation: never the caller's to prompt.

brief.record.inSlot.text: Its brief is given with each of its cards, in the builder's slot.
brief.record.inSlot.note: The lane change's reply, the project's cards built in slots: the brief goes with each card placed there.

brief.record.noSlot.text: No slot is free ({why}): the lane waits for one, and its stopped agents start once it is lent.
brief.record.noSlot.note: #1438: a lane recorded while no slot of the project's is free.

brief.record.started.text: Started {agents} with the lane's brief{hasSlot, select, yes {, in {slot}} other {}}.
brief.record.started.note: The stopped agents started with their brief (agents: their names, joined "a and b"); slot: the slot the builder works in, when the project has slots.

brief.record.tell.text: {agents} {count, plural, one {is running, so Combwork left it as it is: tell it about the lane.} other {are running, so Combwork left them as they are: tell them about the lane.}}
brief.record.tell.note: A running reviewer, or the builder with the rules off: left as they are, for the caller to tell. agents: their names, joined ("a and b").

brief.rule.finish.accept.text: An approved card is accepted where it is (no merge).

brief.rule.finish.agentMerges.text: The builder merges each approved card (merge-ready), then reports it with cw_report_merge; Combwork checks it is in.

brief.rule.finish.committed.text: A card is done once its work is committed.

brief.rule.finish.notChecked.text: Combwork does not check merges: report each one with cw_report_merge.

brief.rule.off.text: Workflow rules are off in this project: the cards move as you put them (cw_update_task).
brief.rule.off.note: The only rule while workflow rules are off.

brief.rule.okBefore.every.text: Every card waits for the user's OK before it is merged (Combwork asks them).
brief.rule.okBefore.every.note: The user's OK before every merge.

brief.rule.okBefore.labels.text: Cards labelled {labels} wait for the user's OK before they are merged (Combwork asks them).
brief.rule.okBefore.labels.note: The user's OK before merging cards with these labels, joined ("ui and api").

brief.rule.preChecks.text: Checks that pass before review: {checks}. Run each as `cw-progress --check <name> --card "<key>"` before submitting.
brief.rule.preChecks.note: The checks the project runs before review, by name, joined ("typecheck and lint").

brief.rule.review.agent.text: A reviewer agent reviews each card before it is merged.

brief.rule.review.agentThenYou.text: A reviewer agent reviews each card, then the user does, before it is merged.
brief.rule.review.agentThenYou.note: Review: an agent, then the user.

brief.rule.review.you.text: The user reviews each card before it is merged.

brief.start.builderFailed.text: {agent} isn't running and couldn't be started ({error}): start it for the lane to go on.
brief.start.builderFailed.note: The lane change's reply: the lane's builder wasn't running, and starting it failed (error: why).

brief.start.builderPrompt.text: Use card-loop as the builder of lane {lane}: cw_lane next names your card.
brief.start.builderPrompt.note: HR2's HI-1900 round 1: a running lane updated while its builder isn't running starts it with one line naming its lane, as coordinate-agents had the Assistant do.

brief.start.builderStarted.text: {agent} wasn't running: started it on the lane.
brief.start.builderStarted.note: The lane change's reply: the lane's builder wasn't running, so Combwork started it with brief.start.builderPrompt.

brief.start.byUser.note: Who started a lane from the window, as the lane records it: its brief says "from the user" to the builder. Stored, so the Default's.

brief.start.firstCard.text: Combwork started this card for you: it is your lane's first card. Use card-loop as its builder (cw_lane next names your cards).
brief.start.firstCard.note: HI-2029: with the rules on, Combwork starts a lane's first card on its builder itself. The note of the card's start prompt.

brief.start.fromUser.note: Who a lane's brief is from, as the delivery records it and its agent's inbox names its sender. Stored, so the Default's.

brief.start.nextCard.text: Combwork started this card for you: it is your lane's next card, after {card} went Done.
brief.start.nextCard.note: Combwork starts a lane's next card on its builder once the one before it is Done. The note of the card's start prompt.

brief.start.notGiven.note: Why an agent didn't start on a lane: its brief's delivery ended without being given (state: cancelled, refused, expired or stale). It is the why in brief.record.failedOne.

brief.start.retryCancel.text: the retry of its new conversation
brief.start.retryCancel.note: Who cancelled the briefs of a lane agent's blocked new conversation, as the delivery records it ("cancelled by …"), as it is tried again. Stored, so the Default's.
